{{Use dmy dates|date=June 2026}}

'''Tarmo Timm''' (born 4 June 1936) is an [[Estonia]]n zoologist ([[Annelida]]).<ref name="ETIS">{{cite web|title=CV: Tarmo Timm|url=https://www.etis.ee/CV/Tarmo_Timm/est|website=www.etis.ee|access-date=4 May 2021}}</ref>

He has described the following taxa:
* ''[[Baltidrilus]]'' <small>Timm, 2013</small>
* ''[[Peipsidrilus]]'' <small>Timm, 1977</small>
